title: Mizzen federation lock
description: The pin of every project's published knowledge bundle: the manifest's own address and hash, and each bundle by SHA-256 with the snapshot it was built from. A build reads only this file and the bundle bytes it names. An optional project with no bundle carries a reason instead of a hash.

source.description: The manifest's address as the config writes it.

bundles.description: Every pinned bundle by project id.

id.description: Stable snapshot id, such as snap-2026-11.

version.description: The project's product version, used for compatibility selection.

commit.description: The commit the snapshot was built from, when one is known.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the stored bundle bytes; absent when the project has none.

source.description: The source the bundle was fetched from, as the manifest wrote it.

optional.description: True when the project may be absent without failing the federation.

missing.description: Why no bundle is pinned, for an optional project that could not be fetched.
